$comment: The curation behind this repository's open `rule-proposal` issues for ReSharper parity.
One entry per proposed Skala concept, plus one line per inspection deliberately excluded.
Every C#-relevant inspection that docs/plan/17's pipeline bucketed `Uncovered` appears
exactly once, in `concepts[].inspections` or in `excluded`. `verify_ledger.py` asserts that.
This is the record doc 17's README asks for: re-run the pipeline rather than re-argue it.

curatedAgainst.warning: 586 was measured on the pipeline BEFORE the id-keyed lookup defect was fixed. A re-run after the fix moves inspections out of `Uncovered` into `Catalogued`/`Hosted`; verify_ledger.py reports those as reconcile items, not failures.
